reviewer: main coordinator (separate from financial continuation agent)
method: Read-only direct source inspection of the standalone settlement handler, payroll run calculation, payroll rule, and payroll payout transaction; no tests or runtime operation executed.

reasoning.observation: Standalone employee payment enforces employees_ledger and bounds the amount against the employee ledger balance; it classifies its debit as Settlement and posts a treasury movement plus ledger entry in one DB transaction.
The Settlement debit and treasury movement commit atomically, so a completed standalone payment is a real persisted outflow rather than only a UI balance change.
Payroll gathers all ledger entries created in the requested calendar month and passes them to CalculatePayrollLines; the input does not classify or net Settlement debits.
The calculation counts named earning credits, selected Deduction/Adjustment debits, and requested advance deductions. It does not subtract Settlement entries from net payable.

Payment checks protected treasury funds and writes PayrollSettlement debits and treasury movement in one transaction, but the shown path pays the frozen NetPayable values without re-reading employee current balance or subtracting prior standalone Settlement.

disposition: SOURCE-CORROBORATED CROSS-FLOW MECHANISM; duplicate payment is conditional on business policy and actual sequence. Do not claim an observed duplicate payment.
counterevidence_and_limits: Code comments explicitly describe PayEmployee as a separate any-time payment mode, so owner intent may be that standalone settlement is intentionally independent of payroll runs.
No source exclusivity or explicit per-period netting rule was found in the reviewed paths; absence in these paths does not establish complete system-wide absence.
No SQL Server integration test, endpoint request, real payment, or live account mutation was executed.
Existing per-flow tests do not establish the combined same-period sequence from this review.
owner_decision: Confirm whether standalone Settlement is intended as a prepayment against earnings included in the same period payroll, or a distinct payable obligation. Do not assume either policy.
remediation_options: If Settlement prepays the same period earnings, calculate remaining liability from an explicit period/earning obligation ledger and account for settlements both before payroll creation and after a run is frozen.
If standalone payment and period payroll are mutually exclusive, enforce the exclusion consistently on both paths and make the state transition atomic.
Preserve per-operation idempotency, protected account checks, audit attribution, frozen-run semantics, and legacy historical payroll records.
required_regression_scenarios: Create earnings, settle the same earnings standalone, then create/approve/pay the period payroll; total disbursement must obey owner-confirmed invariant.
Create/approve payroll, apply standalone settlement, then pay frozen payroll; verify the same obligation cannot be paid twice if owner confirms shared liability.
Use unrelated-period settlements and verify no cross-period netting.
Repeat each request ID and use concurrent different request IDs; validate exactly-once ledger/treasury invariants in a disposable SQL Server integration database.
result: Coordinator source reading corroborates the mechanical overlap described by the existing candidate. The decisive accounting requirement remains unresolved; the candidate is not a confirmed duplicate-payment defect. Independent review does not close financial completion.
